maria: Heads-up — during a quick smoke test of the sample-app I saw log verbosity flip to DEBUG only when auth retry kicked in, and a bunch of follow-up logs lost the request-id (we're getting '***' in some downstream services). Anyone seen this pattern?

sam: hmm, is that the new retry middleware you enabled in the sample app branch? which sample-app? link?

maria: sample-app/node microservice on my laptop with local env. repro: trigger a 401, auth retry does a refresh and retries the same request. Logs before retry have request-id, logs after have scrubbed request-id. quick log excerpt: 

maria: ```
2026-03-18T10:01:03.123Z INFO  request-id=abc123 user=alice GET /profile 200
2026-03-18T10:01:03.456Z WARN  auth retry starting for token-expired
2026-03-18T10:01:03.789Z DEBUG request-id=***      auth:callback refresh-token
2026-03-18T10:01:04.001Z INFO  request-id=*** user=alice GET /profile 200
```

maria: note: redaction shows as `***` which indicates our scrubber ran, but it's weird it only triggers on retries.

leo: likely hook ordering. if the OpenTelemetry/instrumentation hook (that sets the context/trace and request-id) runs before the retry middleware but the retry does a new internal request without propagating the same context, the scrubber could run on a blank header.

chloe: another angle: our redaction lib treats any header named `x-request-id` and if it finds an auth token pattern in any header it scrubs nearby headers (overzealous regex). maybe the refresh response includes a token-looking string and the scrubber hits a false positive.

tyler: can you paste the express middleware order from the sample app? that usually tells the story.

maria: here's the relevant part from `server.js`:

maria: ```js
app.use(otel.instrumentation()); // sets context / traceparent
app.use(metrics.middleware());
app.use(auth.retryMiddleware()); // does refresh + retry
app.use(reqId.middleware()); // attach request id to logs
app.use(redaction.sanitize());
```

sam: ah — `reqId.middleware()` is after the retry. on a retry the middleware stack replays differently (we're using `node-fetch` with a .retry that reconstructs headers) and the reqId attach never runs for the internal retried call. move reqId earlier so retried internal logic still has it.

leo: plus, `redaction.sanitize()` is after reqId, so if reqId is missing the scrubber may still attempt to redact and replace with `***`. ordering: reqId should be as early as possible, ideally immediately after otel.instrumentation.

chloe: also add a guard in the scrubber to only redact tokens that match full-token regex (right now we match any 20+ alnum substring). safer to require token prefixes like `rtk_` or `eyJ` for JWTs.

maria: good call. i'll try swapping middleware order and tightening the regex. quick test: move reqId above auth.retry and run smoke.

ops-bot: deploy: sample-app-smoke-test to staging started by maria at 2026-03-18T10:05:12Z :rocket:

maria: after change: logs look stable, request-id preserved on retries. small follow-up: the traceparent also was being regenerated on retry (trace id changed) which broke span continuity. otel.instrumentation had a subtle race where the retry path re-inits headers. fix: ensure retry reuses original context headers.

tyler: can you open a tiny PR to the sample-app with: (1) middleware reorder, (2) stricter redact regex, (3) a unit test that simulates a 401 + retry and asserts request-id preserved and traceparent unchanged?

maria: yep — i'll open PR `maria/fix/retry-reqid-otel` and add tests + a note in README about middleware ordering for sample-app.

sam: ping me on the PR, happy to review. also we should add a small devex doc about recommended middleware ordering for all SDK sample apps (otel -> req-id -> auth/retry -> business routes -> redaction).

chloe: I'll draft the doc. include a snippet for async retries and a note about `node-fetch` vs `undici` differences in header cloning.

maria: thx all :pray: will follow up with PR link and CI results.

tyler: tiny nit — add an integration smoke job to CI so this regression gets caught.

maria: added to my TODO. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
